subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: Should this PR be allowed to merge after the registry metadata fix and live TTS/Gateway SecretRef proof, or should the persona SecretRef scope wait for broader SecretRef startup/degradation work?
rationale: The code path is a credential-routing surface: the fix is narrow and appropriate, but it changes runtime SecretRef resolution and overlaps adjacent optional-TTS startup work.

options.title: Fix Metadata And Require Live Proof
options.body: Correct the agent persona providerId index, add focused registry coverage, and require redacted live OpenClaw TTS or Gateway proof before merge.

options.title: Accept Current Scope With Targeted Tests
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the credential-routing change based on tests and bundle inspection, but this would leave live runtime behavior unproven for an external PR.

options.title: Pause For Optional-TTS Direction
options.body: Hold this PR until the adjacent optional-missing-TTS SecretRef startup behavior is resolved if maintainers want one combined credential semantics review.

recommendation.title: Fix Metadata And Require Live Proof
recommendation.body: Correct the agent persona providerId index, add focused registry coverage, and require redacted live OpenClaw TTS or Gateway proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: joshavant authored the SecretRef expansion framework that owns the registry and runtime collector contracts touched here.
